title: Reverse Linked List
description: Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list, and return the reversed list.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is the range [0, 5000].
hints: Maintain three pointers: prev, current, next.
Iterate through the list reversing links at each step.

optimalSolution.approach: Maintain prev/current/next pointers and flip each link while walking the list once.

followUpQuestions: Can you reverse the list recursively instead of iteratively?
interviewerNotes: Watch for off-by-one pointer errors and whether candidate handles an empty or single-node list.
